prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 78.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 87.7%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Full Bleed Comic Layout: Redesign the story screen into a full-bleed visual comic layout that introduces the desktop pet origin story before path selection. (why: The choose_path stage has a high mean time of 514s and drop-off to 76.2%, indicating users need an engaging context visual before deciding.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Pet Adoption Customization Split Screen: Redesign the pick_friend screen layout to a split-screen layout clearly separating standard pets from custom photo creation. (why: Adoption stage has a low 60.9% conversion and high mean time of 1017s, plus support received 3 complaints about custom pet creation issues.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Post-Adoption Desktop Controls Showcase Screen: Transform home_intro into a multi-step checklist module showing how to interact with, minimize, and summon the desktop pet. (why: Support received 3 emails about confusion on controlling/hiding pets, and the finish step conversion is low at 64.8%.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Account Recovery Quick Link Hint: Add a prominent sign-in hint reassuring returning users about restoring existing pet data. (why: Sign-in issues generated 8 support emails concerning lost or reset pets after signing back in.)
4: [adoption, layout] Custom Pet Photo Upload Validation Checklist: Change the upload_photos screen layout to a checklist format with clear photo quality guidelines. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failures or poor graphic results.)
5: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Mascot Stamp Seal: Add an interactive official mascot stamp badge to the adoption certificate screen when naming the pet. (why: Adoption conversion is only 60.9%, making it one of the largest drop-off points in the funnel.)
6: [home, wait_info] Desktop Initialization Progress Estimator: Enable accurate time estimates and notification toggles on the rendering wait screen. (why: The waiting step has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing user uncertainty while waiting for the pet to load.)
7: [choose_path, copy] Path Selection Clarification Hint: Update the path selection screen copy to clearly differentiate instant adoption vs custom pet build paths. (why: Path selection takes a mean of 514s, indicating hesitation due to unclear path differences.)
8: [finish, notification] Completion Celebration Audio Welcome: Add a welcoming mascot audio chime component to celebrate completing the final onboarding screen. (why: Overall onboarding completion is low at 20.8%, with 64.8% completion on the final step.)
